lecture_title: Fermions, Dirac Matrices, and the Dirac Sea

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: The exchanged fermionic creation-operator products and minus sign are visible together. The lecturer partly covers the far-left state, so the complete operator identity is independently typeset.
assets.caption_hint: Fermionic exchange represented by anti-commuting creation operators.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Psi dagger of x times psi dagger of y equals minus this over here.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: The equal-point anti-commutator, repeated operator product, factor two, and zero conclusion appear during the exclusion argument. A clean TikZ chain is included beside it.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: This is just twice psi dagger of x times psi dagger of x equals zero.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: The equation H = alpha dot P is centered and legible at the transition to three spatial dimensions; its component expansion is completed in typeset form.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The answer is energy squared equals momentum squared.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: The compact equation H = sigma dot p is unobstructed, and alpha_z = sigma_z remains visible above it.
assets.caption_hint: Massless Hamiltonian as sigma dot momentum.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: In other words, our Hamiltonian h is equal to sigma dot p.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: The alpha and beta block matrices and their anti-commutation conditions are simultaneously visible. The lecturer blocks part of the left margin but not the defining block structure.
assets.caption_hint: A four-by-four block representation of the Dirac matrices.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The anti-commutators are zero of the alphas with beta.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: The filled negative-energy ladder, dividing line, and positive-energy level are visible together during the historical Dirac-sea construction. A clean TikZ reconstruction adds the hole and promoted electron.
assets.caption_hint: Filled negative-energy states in the historical Dirac sea.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: You can remove a negative energy electron from here and put it over here.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_08.png
assets.rationale: All three field-integral lines are visible: the all-momentum expansion, the positive/negative split, and the positron-creation relabeling.
assets.caption_hint: Electron annihilation and positron creation pieces of the fermion field.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: You can think of the field operator as a sum of two terms.

assets.name: lecture_10_figure_09.png
assets.rationale: The emission and annihilation diagrams remain visible beside the schematic interaction psi dagger psi A. The typeset equations identify each channel unambiguously.
assets.caption_hint: Several reaction channels encoded by one local fermion-photon interaction.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: The same operator which took an electron to an electron and a photon takes an electron and a positron and makes a photon.
